en-US.description: Official Desktop client for Nextcloud Talk
en-US.name: Nextcloud Talk
en-US.releaseNotes:
Features
- Switch to log in via the web browser to support SSO and other authentication methods requiring a browser #2033
- Add skipUpdateCheck config, also supported via managed configuration (Windows Policies/macOS User Defaults) #2025

Fixes
- Launch at startup setting in the app may be out of sync with the OS settings #2043, #2044
- Windows: launch at startup setting is lost after an update #2042, #2045
- App crashes when a secondary window is opened a second time #2040
- Windows/MSI: .dll files and the launcher stub .exe are not signed #2034, #2035
- Windows: incorrect friendly application name #2018
- Windows: incorrect firewall rule description #2017
- HTTP cache is not cleared on log out #2010

Changes
- Update built-in Talk v25.0.6 -> v25.0.7 #2038
- Bump Electron 44.4.5 -> 44.10.2 #2016
- Fix local build on Windows arm64 #2039
- Disable unneeded Electron fuses in production: NODE_OPTIONS, Node.js inspect (debug) arguments, and RunAsNode #2037
- Add and enforce an integrity check for JS and asset files (ASAR) #2036
